submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv found that, after adjusting for farm, no candidate exposure showed a robust direct effect on yield_kg. The only nominally significant linear signal was soil_ph (coef ≈ -0.26, p ≈ 0.04), which was the single hypothesis locked and tested with confirm(). The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome ~ soil_ph + farm indicators) gave estimate 0.013, SE 0.121, p = 0.911, far from significance and with the opposite sign. The exploratory signal therefore did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed.

d2 = df.dropna(subset=['soil_ph','yield_kg']).copy()
d2['resid'] = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ C(farm)', data=d2).fit().resid
d2['b'] = pd.qcut(d2['soil_ph'], 8)
print(d2.groupby('b', observed=True)[['soil_ph','resid']].mean().to_string())
"}
